sessions.title: When You Feel Alone
script: Maybe today you spoke to no one who truly understood you.
God still sees what others ignore.
You don't need to perform here.

sessions.title: Anxiety and Rest
script: Your mind has been running too fast.
But you are safe in this moment.

sessions.title: Faith Without Church Walls
script: Not everyone can sit inside a church building.
But faith does not depend on walls.
God is not limited by location.
This is a moment of reflection.
